Q5844.reason: EWS should be applied to any acutely unwell patient and to those pre- or post-operatively, including after major surgery, not limited by age, location, or ICU history.

Q5849.reason: Under the business records exception, testimony that records were kept regularly in the ordinary course of business can establish the foundation, so the records come in.

Q5853.reason: The warning is offered to show the customer had notice of the danger and so may have been contributorily negligent, not for its truth, so it isn't hearsay and is relevant.
